Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug in this channel. You said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.

While the kiosks were down, the guard wrote trailer numbers on a clipboard. That was the workaround you mentioned in that first post.

- **11:03 AM:** Mateo said kiosk 1 was back. The guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it.
- **11:07 AM:** You confirmed both lanes were working again.

So the outage ran about 25 minutes from your report. The messages don't say exactly when the kiosks first failed, only when you reported it. Mateo also reported six trucks waiting at the east gate at 10:44.
